open_points.subject: Personal-data trust boundary
open_points.text: “Personal data — the customer's contact data (R0-06); readable by staff only (R0-09).” contradicts “every contact field it records or reads passes to the provider of the model the owner runs it on — today Anthropic for Claude Code, OpenAI for Codex”.
open_points.question: Does “readable by staff only” describe only Registry API authorization, allowing disclosure to the operator's model provider, or must contact data be inaccessible to every non-staff third party including that provider?
options: Staff-only applies only to direct Registry API access; an operator may disclose the data to its model provider under the provider's terms
Staff-only is an end-to-end restriction; model-backed operators may not process contact data through an external provider
open_points.default_guess: Treat staff-only as an API authorization rule and permit the explicitly accepted disclosure to the operator's model provider.
